contea di ritrovamento: North Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ P M TR P COS II PP

A Roman silver coin: a denarius of Trajan (AD 98-117), dating from AD 99 (Reece period 5), reverse legend P M TR P COS II PP; the reverse depicting Vesta, seated left, holding patera and torch, Rome mint. See Sear, volume 2, number 3143 on page 102. It is 19.6mm in diameter and 2mm thick. It weighs 2.76gm
